overloads.semanticRole: The APPEND TO ARRAY command adds a new element at the end of array and assigns value to the element.

constraints: value's type must be compatible with array's element type or the 4D syntax error 54 ("Argument types are incompatible") is raised; a string array (Text/String) accepts Text or String values, and a number array (Integer/Longint/Real) also accepts Time values.
In interpreted mode, if array does not yet exist, this command creates it with the type of value.
